tagline: KMZ胶片单反相机，1958 年发布
description: KMZ于1958年推出的胶片单反相机。配备KMZ Helios-44 (ГЕЛИОС) 58mm f/2, automatic diaphragm (aluminium barrelled standard lens)。快门速度focal-plane shutter, horizontally run double rubberized silk curtain。使用removable take-up spool。by Fresnel matte glass screen with split-image rangefinder。

specs.镜头: KMZ Helios-44 (ГЕЛИОС) 58mm f/2, automatic diaphragm (aluminium barrelled standard lens)
specs.对焦: by Fresnel matte glass screen with split-image rangefinder
specs.快门: focal-plane shutter, horizontally run double rubberized silk curtain
specs.取景器: SLR pentaprism, matte glass with split-image rangefinder in the central focusing area, 100% frame coverage, finder and screen are interchangeable, there is a waist level finder
specs.闪光灯: two, for X and M, on the left front of the top plate, synch: 1/30s,
specs.英文简介: The Start is a 35mm SLR film camera that manufactured by Mechanical Factory of Krasnogorsk (Krasnogorsky Mekhanichesky Zavod) (KMZ), near Moscov, former USSR, between 1958-64.
